200
Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning successfully retrieved the list of WAS findings export jobs.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permissions to list WAS findings export jobs.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
